answer_1.quote: Each instance allows fine-grained calibration measurement using an incremental question-answering (QA) framework.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the calibration error of six LLMs on GRACE using existing metrics (ECE and Brier scores; Appendix G) and CALSCORE (§ 4).

answer_4.quote: GRACE incorporates human responses from live QA competitions we conduct.
answer_4.guideline: Teams compete by buzzing to interrupt and answer; we log the timing of human teams' buzzes and answer correctness.
